
::: {#def-no-spillover .theorem}
## No spillover assumption

The assumption that no variable in a given observation is a [parent](#def-parent-child) of an [equivalent](#def-equivalence) variable in another [observational unit](#def-observational-unit).


$$
X\notin \mathbf{Pa}(X')\quad
\forall\, X\sim X',\ X\in \mathscr O_i,\ X'\in \mathscr O_j,\ i\ne j.
$$
:::
